## Premise
After the Vorskla Vytautas turns west with nothing but the forest. Samogitia, sold by every treaty, rises in 1401 and 1409 under [Galminas](../characters/galminas.qmd), and the Order under Ulrich prepares its last great crusade. To win, Vytautas must ally with [Jogaila](../characters/jogaila.qmd), the cousin whose men strangled his father, and refuse Henė's shortcut. On the eve of Grunwald he carries the Last Flame in a lantern and swears a thunder-oath that binds Perkūnas. The Iron Saint breaks; Samogitia comes back only for two men's lifetimes.

## Protagonist arc (form at start → form at end)
From the broken Form 5 to **Geležinis Vilkas** (plain armour, Kęstutis's recovered sword, the wolves at his back, the lantern flame) in ch. 2. It ends still in Form 6, hollowed by Thorn, with the first tell of Form 7 (half-deafness from the Five-Voice) in ch. 28. Want: to break the Order. Lie: "I can do it alone". Truth: victory needs the cousin he hates. Cost: pride, Samogitian blood, the Root-Mother's last strength, Galminas.

## Antagonists & outcomes
- **[Ulrich von Jungingen](../characters/jungingen.qmd)** (Grand Master 1407), the [Iron Saint](../forces/iron_saint.qmd) on the field: **killed at Grunwald**; the Iron Saint breaks and the Riders of the Reise scream.
- Secondary: Order commanders in Samogitia; Heinrich von Plauen, who holds Marienburg and signs Thorn; the [White Silence](../forces/white_silence.qmd) at Jadwiga's tomb, which holds.
- [Sigismund](../characters/sigismund.qmd), allied with the Order in 1409–10. [Henė](../forces/shadow_seller.qmd) advises both sides, offers a blood-price shortcut (ch. 8) and is refused.

## Threads advanced (see books/series_arc.md)
- **B:** the flame leaves the vault once, in the lantern (ch. 15, 17). **E:** Perkūnas rewards a kept oath. **F:** the Root-Mother spends her last great strength; Galminas becomes a grove (ch. 19, 23). **G:** Pilkoji sworn (1404), the boy named into the flame (1405–06), vanguard at Grunwald. **I:** Sofija's Moscow as a rival (Ugra). **J:** the Iron Saint broken.
- The pebble warms when the oath is kept. Silent Pact ended; Unbinding holds at 3.

## Hands on to the next book
Samogitia Lithuanian only for the lifetimes of Jogaila and Vytautas (it becomes permanent at Melno, 1422), pagan and waiting for the priests. The Hidden Groves are spent; Eglė begins to fade; the Order is beaten but alive; Henė keeps two stones; and a young secretary, [Zbigniew Oleśnicki](../characters/olesnicki.qmd), has decided that ink will settle Lithuania.
